reviewer: Independent presentation visual QA; no delegated agents
scope: All 50 PPTX entries in build\plan.json; existing local LibreOffice/PyMuPDF renders; no artifact or business-fact edits.
prior_fix_context: This is an independent review of the current post-pilot artifacts. The requester reports earlier title, layout-repetition and spacing fixes; this receipt does not claim the initial pre-fix inspection was flawless or independently certify those earlier versions.
limitations: All slides were visually examined in complete contact sheets, not all at individual-slide resolution. Eight selected dense or suspect slides were additionally opened as individual full-size PNGs.
Forty-two decks have contact-sheet-only visual coverage. Subtle glyph clipping, exact font-size legibility, and small chart-label collisions may not be detectable at that scale.
This review uses existing LibreOffice PDF/PyMuPDF PNG output. Native Microsoft PowerPoint rendering, animations, speaker notes, interactive behavior and accessibility were not tested.

Visual presentation only: no re-audit of business facts, dates, financial arithmetic, canon or semantic content was undertaken. Mechanical receipts were used solely to verify current artifact hashes and slide counts.
Passed means no blocking visual defect was observed within this stated coverage, not flawless design. Minor projection-readability, whitespace and wrapping concerns are retained per document.

documents.evidence: Independent visual review of 'AstroDig LLC - RegolithWorks 1.0 - Ground Campaign Overview': complete contact sheet covering slides 1-11 was inspected for clipping, overlap, wrapping, footer collisions, chart presentation, contrast, margins and alignment. Full-size slide 5 confirms all five evidence-grid text blocks are contained, with aligned card borders, consistent padding and clear footer separation. Examined the wrapped cover title and badge, decision cards, callout boundaries, numbered containment/recovery rows, evidence grid, five-step process cards, use-case/input cards and dark closing slide. Titles stay separate from body content; card edges/columns and numbered rows align consistently. No charts are present. No visible clipping, overlapping text, footer collisions or edge-margin defects were found at the reviewed scales.

issues.description: Technical row/grid text is visually smaller than the surrounding headings and generous whitespace; potentially less comfortable for distant projection, although no cut-off or overlap is visible.

Five narrow process cards create short wrapped lines and substantial empty lower card space. The sequence remains aligned and readable, but this is a polish opportunity rather than an overflow defect.

Footer metadata has low visual prominence and is not readable at contact-sheet scale. No visible footer/content collisions were found; only listed full-size slides were checked at individual-slide scale.

documents.evidence: Independent visual review of 'AstroDig LLC - Engineering foundation - Capital and Readiness Briefing': complete contact sheet covering slides 1-12 was inspected for clipping, overlap, wrapping, footer collisions, chart presentation, contrast, margins and alignment.
